## Purpose

Record the specific evaluated model, question schema and artifact identity allowed to omit static-only modules.

## When a playbook uses it

A local operator after the approved evaluation gate has been met. Session and playbook principals cannot call this command, including elevated supervisors.

## How it works internally

Scope dispatch and the handler independently require the local principal. The database creates an active promotion with operator attribution and time, protected by the single-active-project index. See [`test_selection_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/test_selection_commands.py) and [`service.py`](../../../src/test_selection/service.py).

## Side effects and persistence

Creates `test_selection_promotions` and emits `test_selection.promoted.v1`. It does not enable any feature flag or remove mandatory modules.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`out_of_scope` requires a local operator. `promotion_active` requires inspecting and revoking the existing promotion before creating another identity. Evidence is supplied by the operator; this command does not run the evaluation.

## Example step

Command-step payload (promotion/revocation examples require a local operator context):

```json
{"command": "test_selection_promote", "args": {"project_id": "agent-queue", "model": "jev-1.13.0", "question_schema_version": 1, "catalogue_digest": "sha256:reviewed-catalogue", "rules_digest": "sha256:reviewed-rules", "policy_digest": "sha256:reviewed-policy", "evidence": {"evaluation_report": "reviewed-report"}}}
```
